contentText:
Slayyyter, Suki Waterhouse, Rebecca Black, Stella Lefty and MUNA were just some of the artists that brought the party to Washington, D.C., for the All Things Go festival 2026.

Suki Waterhouse: Hey, Billboard ! It’s Suki Waterhouse.

Rebecca Black: Rebecca Black, and we’re here at All Things Go.

MUNA: Hey, we’re MUNA.

Balu Brigada: We’re Balu Brigada.

Rainbow Kitten Surprise: Hey, it’s Rainbow Kitten Surprise, and we’re here at All Things Go.

All Things Go came out swinging on day one. The sun was shining as fans filled the grounds, bringing full-volume energy from the jump. Early acts such as Underscores and Ninajirachi brought the energy. Meanwhile, breakout Stella Lefty performed her viral hits at her All Things Go debut. Rainbow Kitten Surprise helped kick off the weekend in a major way, delivering the first of many can’t miss performances. The group even caught up with Billboard before hitting the stage for their set, talking about their excitement for their very first All Things Go.
